mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted = 0 AND published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP()

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ( #{type} = 'ALL' OR p.type = #{type} )
AND c.slug = #{categorySlug} AND c.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_tag pt_filter INNER JOIN tag t_filter ON t_filter.id = pt_filter.tag_id WHERE pt_filter.post_id = p.id AND t_filter.slug = #{tagSlug} AND t_filter.deleted = 0 )

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.content_format AS contentFormat,
p.created_by AS authorUserId, pf.display_name AS authorName, pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar,
c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.description AS categoryDescription, c.deleted AS categoryDeleted,
p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime, p.status, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount
FROM post p
INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = p.created_by
LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ( #{type} = 'ALL' OR p.type = #{type} )
AND c.slug = #{categorySlug} AND c.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_tag pt_filter INNER JOIN tag t_filter ON t_filter.id = pt_filter.tag_id WHERE pt_filter.post_id = p.id AND t_filter.slug = #{tagSlug} AND t_filter.deleted = 0 )
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.content_format AS contentFormat,
p.created_by AS authorUserId, pf.display_name AS authorName, pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar,
c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.description AS categoryDescription, c.deleted AS categoryDeleted,
p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime, p.status, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount
FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.type = 'TECH' AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, NULL AS content, p.content_format AS contentFormat,
p.created_by AS authorUserId, pf.display_name AS authorName, pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar,
c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.description AS categoryDescription, c.deleted AS categoryDeleted,
p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime, p.status, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount
FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE p.type = 'TECH' AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.id != #{postId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.content_format AS contentFormat,
p.created_by AS authorUserId, pf.display_name AS authorName, pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar,
NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, NULL AS categorySlug, NULL AS categoryDescription, NULL AS categoryDeleted,
p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime, p.status, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount
FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = p.created_by
WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.type = 'MOMENT' AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) LIMIT 1

SELECT pt.post_id AS postId, t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, t.slug AS tagSlug, t.deleted AS tagDeleted
FROM post_tag pt
INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
WHERE pt.post_id IN
#{postId}
ORDER BY pt.post_id, t.name, t.id

SELECT pm.post_id AS postId, pm.id, pm.usage_type AS usageType, pm.media_type AS mediaType, pm.url, pm.poster_url AS posterUrl, pm.alt_text AS altText, pm.width, pm.height, pm.sort_order AS sortOrder
FROM post_media pm
WHERE pm.deleted = 0 AND pm.post_id IN
#{postId}
ORDER BY pm.post_id, pm.sort_order, pm.id

SELECT p.id,p.type,p.slug,p.title,p.summary,p.content,p.content_format AS contentFormat, p.created_by AS authorUserId,pf.display_name AS authorName,pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar, c.id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName,c.slug AS categorySlug,c.description AS categoryDescription,c.deleted AS categoryDeleted, p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt,p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime,p.status,p.like_count AS likeCount,p.comment_count AS commentCount,p.version FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id=p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.deleted=0 AND (#{type}='ALL' OR p.type=#{type}) AND (#{status}='ALL' OR p.status=#{status}) ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id,p.type,p.slug,p.title,p.summary,p.content,p.content_format AS contentFormat, p.created_by AS authorUserId,pf.display_name AS authorName,pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar, c.id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName,c.slug AS categorySlug,c.description AS categoryDescription,c.deleted AS categoryDeleted, p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt,p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime,p.status,p.like_count AS likeCount,p.comment_count AS commentCount,p.version FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id=p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.type=#{type} AND p.deleted=0 LIMIT 1
